US suspends green card filings for Indian IT workers amid visa probe

The United States has suspended green card filings for employees of Indian IT firm Cognizant, citing an investigation into alleged H-1B visa fraud. The move affects Indian professionals seeking permanent residency in the US. The Trump administration has intensified its crackdown on H-1B visa practices. This action is seen as a potential setback for Indian IT professionals aiming for long-term stays in the US.
